passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. David Abbott, Rep. Beau Baird, Rep. Brad Barrett, Rep. Steve Bartels, Rep. Robert Behning

passages.note: House roll call 382 adopting Conference Committee Report #1 on HB 1296 is the vote on the bill's final text, not a cloture, table, recommit or other procedural motion; Behning is in the Yea column and 30 of 100 members voted Nay, so it is not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana.
passages.note: Enrolled act HEA 1296 — CC 1, the text adopted in roll call 382; SECTION 12 ends the state carry-license requirement for adults not otherwise prohibited, and SECTION 10, SECTION 11 and SECTION 14 repeal sections of the handgun licensing chapter.

rows.reasoning: Behning co-authored HB 1296 (2022), "Firearms matters", and voted Yea on the conference committee report that enacted it, a single-subject firearms bill whose operative section provides that an adult not otherwise prohibited "is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana." That text, together with "SECTION 10. IC 35-47-2-2 IS REPEALED", "SECTION 11. IC 35-47-2-2.1 IS REPEALED" and "SECTION 14. IC 35-47-2-24 IS REPEALED", matches both clauses of the rung "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit." It passes the ceiling of the rung that would "Add no new restrictions, and at most loosen rules on carrying, such as honoring permits across state lines", because it abolishes the permit requirement rather than extending recognition of permits.
